title: Applicability of Special Transit Land Use District Regulations
previewText: Wherever the Special 125th Street District includes an area which also lies within the Special Transit Land Use District, the requirements of the Special Transit Land Use District, as set forth in Article IX, Chapter 5, shall apply, except as modified by the provisions of the Chapter.
